Hi Mark,

Please upgrade to the latest version (2.6.21) where this is fixed.

> update.packages()

or

> install.packages("rattle") 

Thanks,
Graham



On 27 September 2012 18:38, Mark Webb <targetl...@gmail.com> wrote:
I'm working through the Association Analysis chapter in Graham Williams latest book - Data Mining...........The art of..........
I can load the DVD dataset, run the Apriori to generate the rules, can draw the freq plot, can change the support & confidence setting but when I click the Show Rules button nothing is displayed. I get the following error message -

Warning message:
In is.na(x) : is.na() applied to non-(list or vector) of type 'S4'
Error in inspect(sort(crs$apriori, by = "confidence")) : 
  error in evaluating the argument 'x' in selecting a method for function 'inspect': Error in x[order(x, na.last = na.last, decreasing = decreasing)] : 
  error in evaluating the argument 'i' in selecting a method for function '[': Error in slot(x, s)[i] : subscript out of bounds
> 

I'm using rattle 2.6.17
Any suggestions ?
Regards
Mark
